system.name: ServerlessLLM
system.one_liner: a low-latency serverless inference system for large language models that optimizes checkpoint loading, live migration and scheduling

components.name: Controller
components.role: dispatches inference requests to GPU nodes and to cloud storage

components.name: Request Router
components.role: routes incoming requests to nodes already running LLM inference or triggers loading

components.name: Model Loading Scheduler
components.role: activates LLM inference processes on unallocated GPUs, deciding where to start a model

components.name: GPU Server
components.role: node running an inference process on GPUs

components.name: Inference Process
components.role: GPU process/container downloading and loading the model checkpoint through SSD and DRAM into GPU memory

components.name: LLM
components.role: the loaded language model generating tokens iteratively from input tokens

components.name: KV Cache
components.role: caches intermediate computations to accelerate subsequent token generation

components.name: Input Tokens
components.role: user-specified prompt tokens fed to the LLM

components.name: Output Tokens
components.role: tokens streamed back to the requesting client

components.name: Next Token
components.role: iteratively generated token checked against an end-of-sentence condition

components.name: Fast Multi-Tier Checkpoint Loading
components.role: novel design that speeds up checkpoint loading using in-server multi-tier storage

components.name: Efficient Live Migration of LLM inference
components.role: novel design coordinating GPU servers and the controller for locality-driven live migration

components.name: Startup-Time-Optimized Model Scheduling
components.role: novel scheduling policy in the controller that minimizes model startup latency

flows.what: route to node already running inference

flows.from: Efficient Live Migration of LLM inference

content.key_idea: ServerlessLLM introduces three designs -- fast multi-tier checkpoint loading, efficient live migration, and startup-time-optimized scheduling -- layered onto the standard GPU serverless cluster components (controller, GPU server, LLM inference loop) to minimize model startup latency.
content.reading_order: left to right, top to bottom: an inference request enters the Controller (Request Router / Model Loading Scheduler), which allocates a GPU Server that downloads from Model Storage and runs the LLM Inference loop on the right; three contribution boxes at the bottom point up via dashed arrows to the components they optimize.

summary: ServerlessLLM is a system for low-latency serverless inference of large language models. This overview figure shows the standard GPU serverless cluster components -- a Controller (with a Request Router and Model Loading Scheduler) that dispatches inference requests to a GPU Server running an Inference Process, which downloads model checkpoints from Model Storage through SSD/DRAM into GPU memory -- alongside a zoomed-in LLM Inference loop (Input Tokens through the LLM and KV Cache, producing Next Token/Output Tokens until an end-of-sentence token). Three novel designs are overlaid at the bottom of the figure and connected by dashed arrows to the parts of the architecture they target: Fast Multi-Tier Checkpoint Loading, Efficient Live Migration of LLM Inference, and Startup-Time-Optimized Model Scheduling. The diagram is a dense, small-font flat box diagram split into a left 'Serverless Cluster' panel and a right 'LLM Inference' panel, using blue fill only for GPU boxes.
summary_zh: 图1展示GPU无服务器集群的基本组件：控制器(含请求路由器与模型加载调度器)将推理请求分派给运行推理进程的GPU服务器，进程从模型存储下载检查点经SSD/DRAM载入GPU；右侧展示LLM推理循环(输入token经LLM与KV缓存生成输出token直至结束符)。底部虚线箭头标出ServerlessLLM的三项新设计：多级检查点加载、高效实时迁移与启动时间优化调度。
